items.title: In-hand phone with a black 'Thinking...' pill
items.description: A hand holds a phone whose screen is a pale gradient with a single black 'Thinking...' pill near the bottom - an AI processing moment, not a settings button.

items.title: Mom+Pop Music - 'More By Porter Robinson' with a live player pill
items.description: A dark music screen: '© 2026 Sample Sized, LLC... Mom+Pop Music', 'More By Porter Robinson' shelf, a now-playing pill ('Perfect Pinterest Garden (Ninajirachi...' - Porter Robinson) with pause/next, and a Home/grid/wallet/lyrics/search dock. A label-page moment.

items.title: muso - black vinyl card with a peel-down orange tab
items.description: A black grooved card reading 'muso' with an orange download tab and the instruction 'peel the orange tab down'. A tactile download metaphor, not receipt OCR.

items.title: Most read - a shelf of article spines with one open cover
items.description: A light 'Most read' shelf: dozens of coloured book spines (article titles) with two opened covers (incl. a Joe Biden memoir) and 'Read the article' links. A reading-list visualised as a bookshelf.

items.title: Agent queue - 'wait 50 seconds pls' with Steer controls
items.description: A dark agent chat: 'Waited 20 seconds.' then 'wait 50 seconds pls', a queue list (queue/test/cool each with Steer, trash, edit) and a 'Reply to task' composer. A task-steering queue.

items.title: AI design chat - community-page critique beside a plant update
items.description: Two panels: a long text critique with yellow highlights about redesigning a community page, and a 'Vibe' chat where the user shares 'My new plant sprouted a leaf! It's the little things.' above 'What would you like to change or create?'. A design-assistant thread, not travel.

items.title: Offloop welcome - 3D gradient blobs and agent hiring pitch
items.description: 'Welcome to Offloop - Join and hire the best agents to your brand new workspace and work together' with rainbow 3D blobs and a signature, Continue with Google / Continue with Email, inside a simulator frame. An agent-workspace onboarding.

items.title: Blank compose screen - cream field over an iOS keyboard
items.description: A nearly empty cream screen whose lower half is the iOS keyboard (You/We/I bar). A compose/entry moment, not a calendar.

items.title: Onbo Hub - 'It's biology, not laziness' sleep lesson with owl
items.description: An 'Onbo Hub' (JA/EN, Yuma Ueno) video page: phone showing 'It's biology, not laziness - Your body wakes up before your brain does.' with a sleepy owl, red Continue, then player controls (0:20/1:46, speeds to 4x) and onbo-hub.com. A sleep-education lesson.

items.title: Trash cleaner - 36/38 photos and a Compress Media sheet
items.description: A 'Trash 36/38 · 100% · 502 MB' photo grid with red corner badges, over a 'Compress Media' sheet (ORIGINAL 393 KB → COMPRESSED 357 KB, SAVED 35 KB, COMPRESSING 7 OF 36). A cleanup/compression tool, not Collections.

items.title: Roll the Dice - two 3D dice mid-roll in hand
items.description: A hand holds a phone showing 'Roll the Dice' with two tumbling 3D dice and a 'Rolling...' footer, filmed at a hobby desk. A dice-roll moment, not a camera control.

items.title: Scroll reader - two-column parchment with a bookmark ribbon
items.description: An iPhone 17 Pro frame showing a parchment book spread: two dense text columns, a gold bookmark ribbon below and a blue gear button, with a desktop cursor hovering. A scroll/reader screen, not settings.

items.title: Water tracker - indigo bottle at 88% with a 250ml add card
items.description: An indigo hydration screen: 3D bottle, '88% Completed', 2.80L Daily goal / 2,450ml Consumed, and a white '250ml + Add' card with a dot-to-bar intake chart and tool icons. A bold water tracker.

items.title: Receipt scan - 'Квитанция' with Telegram and VK share
items.description: A held phone showing a Russian receipt capture titled 'Квитанция': a pink scanned receipt with detected fields and Telegram/VK share buttons. A receipt-OCR share moment, not flower capture.

items.title: Hand-held journal - 'Wed 23' photo header in warm lamplight
items.description: A hand holds a phone beside a glowing lamp: a journal page with a 'Wed 23' photo header (23 September 2026) and dated entries (22/21 September) in soft type. A quiet journaling moment.

items.title: Kids' money app - 'Hi Maya, you can spend $48.60'
items.description: A store panel: 'Hi Maya - You can spend $48.60 (+$12 on Wednesday)' with blue Send it / green Ask for more tiles, Incoming 'Allowance from Elena +$12', Transactions 'To Vacation -€3.00' and a Home/Save/Jobs/Card nav. The allowance home of the Maya app.

items.title: Kids' money app - Skateboard goal and piggy banks
items.description: A store panel: 'Skateboard - $34 to go' yellow card ($55, 62% saved, Add more) and 'More Piggy Banks' (General $55, Games $256, Fashion $15, +). The savings half of the Maya app.

items.title: Kids' money app - 'Ask Elena $24' and the Spreat card
items.description: Two panels: 'Ask Elena - $24' with reason chips (Skateboard bits, School trip, A present) and 'Or walk Rocco and earn $4 of it yourself', Send the ask; and 'Your card' with a black Spreat card (4417, MAYA) and Spent this week. The ask/card half of the Maya app.

items.title: 'Create Freely' - doodle knight chicken on black
items.description: A dark store panel: scribbled white doodles (spiral, crown, burst) around a 3D chicken knight with paper shield and pixel sword, 'Create Freely - Build Unique Characters With Simple Assets, Endless Combinations, And Your Own Creative Touch.' and Let's Create. A character-creator splash.

items.title: Arc - eight dark store panels from arcs to pricing
items.description: Eight dark panels for 'Arc': Create and Join Arcs, Achievement and streaks badges (two variants), 'Pick your interests' chips (Fitness, Conditioning, Cooking, Travel, Productivity, Finance), 'Arcs according to your interests' (Gut Health Arc), Choose the day to start, and 'Upgrade you live with Arc' pricing. A complete store gallery.

items.title: Faith app - sixteen cream/green panels of devotion
items.description: Sixteen panels of a faith journal ('DearBend'): 'Grow closer to God, a little more everyday', Commitment pact, Test your learnings, Journal, 'You've already taken a powerful step (86% of users)', 'Every journey of faith is unique', Along the Road, 'Say one honest sentence about God...', Explorer and 'You did great today!'. A devotional store gallery.

items.title: Helexthy - eight dark onboarding panels to plan pricing
items.description: Eight dark panels for 'Helexthy': 'Build a life that works for you', 'One system for your whole day', 'Make progress feel simple' (39% ring), 'What is your main goal now?', profession, obstacles, 'What should Helexthy Protect?' and 'Choose the plan that fits your goals' ($6/$19). A health-coaching store gallery.
